_about: t21 (D51): t20_base.json (the t20 network: dual camera features, L4 lane branch, motion block, delta slots, 1 m centre-line head, hygiene fixes, split 'large') warm-started from the finished baseline runs/t20_base_s0 (init_from: its EMA weights, optimiser and schedule fresh; cam_buffer adds no parameter, so no key is fresh) and trained 1500 steps at lr 1e-4 with warm-up 100, ema 0.99 and a validation every 750 steps (t20_base: 6000 steps, lr 3e-4, ema 0.999, validation every 2000); everything else as t20_base.json (seed 0, batch 3, accum 2, clips of 3 keyframes with the state kept in the graph, flip augmentation). The arms of the experiment (pair, pair4, rec, ctl) differ in model.cam_buffer, n_cam and cam_stride only: model.cam_buffer 'pair', n_cam 2: the camera temporal block's window is ONE buffered frame, the previous one (frames t and t-2 sweeps = 0.167 s apart; in stream mode the previous raw camera BEV comes from state['buf']). The motion block reads the same two raw BEVs, so its time baseline is 0.167 s instead of the window's oldest frame (0.333 s).
name: t21_pair
